description: Envelope validation of a product configuration against the specification: checks every binding against the product's supports* envelopes. When a value is not in this template's envelope but another template takes every bound value, the result carries alsoOfferedBy (ranked) and switchHint — switch product and validate again rather than dropping what the buyer asked for (a poster on aluminium composite is a panel print). Maps numeric substrate-weight (gsm) to its weight band via the bands' minWeight/maxWeight properties, and returns data-driven advisories (e.g. creasing recommended above the scoring thresholds). NOTE: this validates the ENVELOPE only — cross-variable legality (e.g. valid panel counts per fold topology) and vendor capability matching are an implementation's concern (a configurator), not the specification's; commercial values (date, price) are not configuration and belong to the transaction layer. Elicitation contract (shared by every ptpge_* tool): whenever a result carries `needs_disambiguation`, each entry has a `field`, a `question` that MUST be put to the user verbatim, and `candidates` — never infer the answer, never fingerprint until it is resolved. SD-0083: the validator also checks completeness — a missing REQUIRED axis of the product (setup/fold, format, page count, binding, colour on the first face, shape where shape is the product) returns needs_disambiguation with the envelope's candidates; a required axis with exactly one allowed value is bound for you as envelope-implied; a surface name that is not a face of the bound setup (faces: flat-sheet front/back, folded-sheet outside/inside, multi-page front-cover…back-cover) is rejected with the allowed faces. `complete: true` means an identity can be issued. SD-0104 spot inks: a spot-color layer in color-mode is not identified until it is named — bind variables/features/spot-ink on the same face with the value <matching-system term>/<code>: Pantone 300 C → printing/standards/color-systems/color-matching-systems/pantone-matching-system/300-c, HKS 43 K → …/color-matching-systems/hks/43-k, RAL 5015 → …/ral/5015 (code lower-case, spaces as hyphens; checked for form only). One spot-ink per spot-color layer; two spots = color-mode values [cmyk, spot-color, spot-color] + two spot-ink values. Fewer inks than layers → needs_disambiguation; the specification sets no limit on the number of spot colours (the press does).

provenance.description: How this value came about (SD-0071): 'confirmed' — the buyer chose it; 'inferred' — you derived it without asking; 'policy-default' — a house rule supplied it. Never part of the fingerprint; identity is the product, not the conversation. Set it honestly: a vendor may refuse an order whose colour was never confirmed.

unit.description: custom-width / custom-height only: the unit the value is stated in. Converted to mm before validation and identity (the identity is always mm).
